repositories.description: An observability toolkit for teams operating distributed event systems.
repositories.readme:
# Signal Harbor

Signal Harbor connects traces, lag metrics, and event schemas so platform teams can diagnose distributed streams from one workspace.

## Features

It correlates consumer lag with deployments and schema changes.

## Installation

Run npm install signal-harbor.

## License

Licensed under the Example License.

repositories.description: A policy simulator for infrastructure teams evaluating access changes.
repositories.readme:
# Gatehouse

Gatehouse simulates infrastructure access policies before teams deploy them.

## Installation

```bash
cargo install gatehouse
gatehouse apply policy.yaml
```

## API Reference

Call evaluate(policy, request).
